headline: SUNY Cortland carries SUNYAC into December
dek: SUNY Cortland is the sole conference side still playing, having won sixteen matches and lost only three across the season while drawing three more. Cortland has scored 46 goals and conceded twelve, following a win over Denison with an upcoming match against Carnegie Mellon.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring across the conference is sharply stratified, with SUNY Oneonta's 50 goals surpassing the combined totals of SUNY Cobleskill, SUNY Canton, and SUNY Delhi.

wire.line: Conference sides have scored 140 goals and conceded 124 outside league play despite 38 wins, seventeen draws, and 40 losses.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: SUNY Cortland goalkeeper Jordan Ott has posted fourteen shutouts while conceding twelve goals across the season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: SUNY Oneonta has spread its attack across at least sixteen distinct goal scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Oswego midfielder Ian Husselbeck has scored nine goals from eighteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four scheduled matches have passed their dates without a published result: Oswego at Onondaga Community, Oswego against William Smith, Alfred State at Alfred, and Fredonia against Jamestown CC.

last_match.line: SUNY Cortland handed Denison a defeat after Denison had beaten Plattsburgh, extending Cortland's unbeaten run since October.

next_match.line: SUNY Cortland enters on a winning streak and is the only conference side with a match left on the schedule.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
